name: Wall Breaker MR
summary:
**DESTROY YOUR REAL WALLS!**

Ever wanted to just... break everything?

 Wallbreaker MR beams a retro-arcade classic right into your home, but with a destructive twist. Using the power of Mixed Reality, this app scans your environment in seconds and turns any wall into a target.
This isn't a simulation. Your room IS the game, and your goal is to smash it to pieces.

**THIS IS AN EARLY ACCESS APP**

This app is a work-in-progress.

 We're launching in Early Access because we need your help!
